24.7.2026

(1)

Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 should be simplified.

Article 1

Amendments to Regulation (EU) 2024/1689

Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 is amended as follows:

(1)

the following Article is inserted:

‘Article 4a

Processing of special categories of personal data

1. Providers may exceptionally process special categories of personal data.’

;

(2)

Article 5 is amended as follows:

(a)

in paragraph 1, the first subparagraph, the following points are inserted:

‘(ba)

the use of an AI system that generates intimate imagery without consent;

(bb)

the use of an AI system that generates child sexual abuse material;’

(3)

in Article 10, paragraph 5 is deleted;

(4)

in Article 40(2), the following subparagraph is added:

‘The Commission shall request, in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012 of 25 October 2012, the drafting of standards.’

(5)

in Article 111, the following paragraph is added:

‘4. Providers of systems placed on the market before 2 August 2026 shall comply with Article 50(2) by 2 December 2026.’

(6)

in Article 113, the third paragraph is amended as follows:

(a)

point (a) is replaced by the following:

‘(a)

Chapters I and II shall apply from 2 February 2025, with the exception of Article 5(1), points (ba) and (bb), which shall apply from 2 December 2026;’

(7)

in Annex VIII, section B, points 7 and 9 are deleted;

Article 2

Amendments to Regulation (EU) 2018/1139

Regulation (EU) 2018/1139 is amended as follows:

(1)

in Article 17, the following paragraph is added:

‘3. The requirements of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 shall be taken into account.’

Article 4

Entry into force and application

This Regulation shall enter into force on the third day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.
